simpleshops.guide.page.1.title: Simple Shops
simpleshops.guide.page.1: Player shops: a Sales Block with a price and a Display Case with up to five goods, protected from strangers and explosions. Buyers swap price items for one piece per trade.
simpleshops.guide.page.2.title: Display Case
simpleshops.guide.page.2: A glass case with five goods slots that shows what is for sale; the lid is glass too, so the goods are visible from above.
simpleshops.guide.page.3.title: Display Case
simpleshops.guide.page.3: It stands anywhere, but it is a shop (protected, sells) only on a Sales Block of the same owner. Craft:
simpleshops.guide.page.4.title: Display Case
simpleshops.guide.page.4: 8 iron nuggets, 1 glass block, 1 wooden pressure plate (plate below, glass in the middle, nuggets around). The Glow Display Case (Display Case + glow ink sac, shapeless) draws the goods fully bright and gives off weak light (6).
simpleshops.guide.page.5.title: Sales Block
simpleshops.guide.page.5: The cash register of a shop: a wooden block under the Display Case. One price per Sales Block, up to five price items, plus 27 slots for the earnings. Craft: 4 planks, 2 iron ingots, 1 ender pearl, 1 hopper (on top), 1 chest.
simpleshops.guide.page.6.title: Sales Block
simpleshops.guide.page.6: Its owner is the player who placed it.
simpleshops.guide.page.7.title: Sales Storage
simpleshops.guide.page.7: Chest-sized extra store for the earnings. Sneak and right click your own Sales Block with it, on any side:
simpleshops.guide.page.8.title: Sales Storage
simpleshops.guide.page.8: it attaches there, facing the Sales Block, and pulls the earnings out of it like a hopper. Anywhere else it does not place at all.
simpleshops.guide.page.9.title: Buying
simpleshops.guide.page.9: Click the Display Case or the Sales Block: pick a goods stack, put the price items into the pay slots (same positions as the price row) and press Trade.
simpleshops.guide.page.10.title: Buying
simpleshops.guide.page.10: One piece of the chosen goods per trade; shift-click repeats while price, goods and room last.
simpleshops.guide.page.11.title: Server shop
simpleshops.guide.page.11: An unlimited shop that only operators (permission level 2) create and configure with /servershop. Everybody, operators included, buys from it in the normal buyer menu.
simpleshops.guide.page.12.title: Ender shops
simpleshops.guide.page.12: Like an ender chest: the goods, prices and earnings of every shop live in the world data, the blocks are only windows onto them. That is why the Sales Block and the Sales Storage need an ender pearl.
simpleshops.guide.page.13.title: Protection
simpleshops.guide.page.13: A placed shop belongs to its owner (the player who placed it, saved by UUID on the server).
simpleshops.guide.page.14.title: Protection
simpleshops.guide.page.14: Only the owner and operators (permission level 2) can break it; the owner always can, also in a foreign claim and after claim rights changed.
simpleshops.guide.page.15.title: Claims and Simple Money
simpleshops.guide.page.15: Standalone, a shop works everywhere. With claims (Simple Tweaks) a shop can only be placed where its owner may build (build right B); buying needs no right at all.
simpleshops.guide.page.16.title: Creative tabs
simpleshops.guide.page.16: The module's items sit in its own creative tab and are also sorted into the fitting Vanilla tabs and the search tab.
simpleshops.guide.page.17.title: Commands
simpleshops.guide.page.17: /simpleshops config shows and changes every option of config/simpleshops-server.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simpleshops.guide.page.18.title: Commands
simpleshops.guide.page.18: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once; options read only at start say so. Permission level 2.
simpleshops.guide.page.19.title: Settings
simpleshops.guide.page.19: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
